units.source_text: 不久源氏公子恢复了官爵，又升任了权大纳言。

en.t: Before long, Prince Genji was restored to his rank and offices, and was further promoted to provisional major counselor.

units.source_text: 凡以前因公子而贬斥的人，都恢复了原官位。

en.t: All those who had previously been demoted because of the prince were restored to their former official positions.

units.source_text: 其欣欣向荣之状，正如枯木逢春，实甚可喜。

en.t: The flourishing scene was just like withered trees meeting spring again, and was truly a cause for joy.

units.source_text: 有一天，朱雀帝召见，源氏公子入觐，帝于玉座前赐坐。

en.t: One day, Emperor Suzaku summoned him; Prince Genji came to court, and the emperor granted him a seat before the imperial throne.

units.source_text: 左右众宫女等，尤其是桐壶帝时代以来侍奉至今的老年宫女等，看见了源氏公子，都觉得他的相貌长得更加堂皇了。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting around the court, especially the elderly attendants who had served since Emperor Kiritsubo's reign, saw Prince Genji and all felt that his appearance had become still more noble and imposing.

units.source_text: 想起了他几年来怎么能久居在那荒凉的海边，大家不胜悲戚，不免号哭了一番，并叹赏公子的美貌。

en.t: When they thought of how he had endured living for years on that desolate seashore, they were overcome with sorrow, could not help weeping aloud for a while, and marveled at the prince's beauty.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝对于公子自觉有愧，此次隆重召见，服装特别讲究。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku felt a sense of guilt toward the prince, and for this solemn audience he took particular care with his attire.

units.source_text: 他近来心情不佳，身体十分衰弱。

en.t: Recently he had been in low spirits, and his body was extremely weakened.

units.source_text: 但昨今两日以来，略觉好些，便与源氏公子纵谈各事，直至入夜。

en.t: But over the past two days he had felt somewhat better, so he spoke freely with Prince Genji about many matters until night fell.
